_comment: W5 JH check-in chain records. Values are from the local production assembly (real router/transactions + simulated database) on 2026-11-12; no CloudBase call and no phone was used.

cases.name: same-day concurrent taps keep one row
cases.expected: Two concurrent check-ins, including a replay, leave exactly one place_checkins row.
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: same-day new requests and concurrent taps keep one row

cases.name: original request after midnight replays the original day
cases.expected: Replaying the original requestId returns the original date/completedAt and does not create today's row.
cases.actual: Original visit replayed with replayed:true; a new request creates the new day.
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: same-day new requests and concurrent taps keep one row

cases.name: same requestId with a different place conflicts
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: same-day new requests and concurrent taps keep one row

cases.name: a retired place rejects new check-ins but keeps owner history
cases.expected: New campus.checkIn for a place no longer in PLACES returns INVALID_INPUT; campus.checkinHistory still returns the old row.
cases.actual: INVALID_INPUT; history total 1 with the retired placeId; no state change.
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: a retired place rejects new checkins but keeps its owner history

cases.name: client history labels a retired place without offering it
cases.expected: History shows 已下架地点; complete() does not send a request for it.
cases.actual: Fallback label rendered; zero campus.checkIn requests.
cases.evidence: tests/campus-history-client.test.js: history keeps a retired place but never offers it as a new checkin

cases.name: campus pause preserves receipt, day status and export
cases.expected: Existing receipt and day read still work; new writes answer NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: campus pause preserves the original receipt, day status and export while blocking new writes

cases.name: account isolation and history pagination
cases.expected: A cannot read B history; paging is stable; legacy visits remain readable.
cases.actual: Pass across modern and legacy fixtures.

cases.name: check-ins enter export and cleanup
cases.expected: JSON/Markdown export includes the self-reported visit; cleanup removes only the owner rows.
cases.actual: Pass in the simulated export/cleanup path.
cases.evidence: tests/manual-campus-checkin.test.js: manual checkins isolate accounts, invalidate exports and are exported; disabled account cleanup

notExecuted: target cloud moodsky-release: campus.checkIn/campus.checkins are reported ACTION_NOT_FOUND
real phone: Xiaomi 14 Ultra feedback shows 接口不存在; no successful write observed
file export delivery, 24-hour expiry and cleanup job on real storage

change.summary: Stored history validates the place id shape instead of current catalogue membership; new writes still require a current PLACE. Client history accepts the same shape and renders 已下架地点 as a fallback.
